title: Cutting Crew Album Cover
coreRelationships: Fragmented photographic elements are arranged to form a collage.
Warm yellow and orange hues dominate the background and photographic elements.
Sharp, angular blue lines provide a contrasting accent.
Text elements are placed on top of the fragmented imagery.
reuseFormula: Create a fragmented photographic collage of faces in warm yellow/orange tones. Overlay a black rectangular box for the main title (white, bold, geometric sans-serif) and a diagonal light blue handwritten script for secondary text, accented by sharp blue lines.
